coil_field.layout_dependence: the OCP loop area is set by G08's Kelvin routing and by the In1 ocp_kelvin_p pour, which contests In1 with G06's n_ls LS block (patches21.ZONE_WINNERS); stage 28's router re-laid ocp_node / ocp_thresh when G10 changed, and the pickup went 4.17 -> 4.78 A (DECISIONS 30)
coil_field.source: coil current (tank, G04 via J2 / J5; coil off board)

G08.loop: OCP Kelvin + comparator node / threshold loops (R5, R33, R35, C30, C31, U6)

G09.loop: CT comparator loops and LINE_ZC string
G09.source_file: 02-protection-timing/coil-pickup/PICKUP.md lines 9-10 (13b copper; not rerun per stage)
G09.value: negligible (<= 0.35 A tank-current equivalent, <= 0.6 deg ZC shift; LINE_ZC nA / ns)

controls.control: B3 c18_h10 run is on the stage-43 board
thermal: attributed + unattributed heat = B3 source watts
[c28_h25_p1p0] B3 c28_h25 run is on the stage-43 board
[c28_h25_p1p0] thermal: attributed + unattributed heat = B3 source watts
coil field: OCP pickup row equals the s43 scorecard
return path: open changes equal the s43 scorecard
creepage: RES_A outer minimum equals the s43 scorecard

method:
Layer 3, coupling that is on no net: heat, coil field, return-path references, switch-node dv/dt, creepage.

    python3 -I validation-results/13-coupling/scripts/physics.py      (after assign.py)

No new physics: each term reads an existing model's input or output for the stage-43 board.
* Thermal (B3, 04-board-current-thermal/round5-native21/b3, run c18_h10_p1p0 on board 61447816; run c28_h25_p1p0 also, for continuity): the solver's own
  deposited-heat map heat_w (1 mm cells) is attributed to groups - cells under a heat-source part's courtyard to that
  part's group, the rest to the nets of the case's Joule-heated copper (sw_a / sw_b / res_a / coil_feed / leg / bus /
  ac nets) by which copper occupies the cell. Screen: heat of group i deposited within 5 mm and 15 mm of group j's
  courtyards (W), and each group's hottest part from the solved rise map. This is proximity on B3's own heat, not a
  new solve.
* Coil field (02-protection-timing/coil-pickup): OCP Kelvin / comparator pickup on this board (s21b/result-s43.json,
  the scorecard's ocp_pickup_stack_pan60_A) against its 6.5 A gate; CT and LINE_ZC verdicts from PICKUP.md.
* Return-path references (return-path.json of the stage-43 chain): which groups' planes and transfer capacitors each
  fast or slow signal's layer changes lean on; the open changes (> 3 mm or no cap) per group pair.
* dv/dt: copper area of the switching domains (SW_A, SW_B nets) overlapping other domains' copper on the adjacent
  layer (plane-to-plane capacitance proxy, mm2) and same-layer copper within 1 mm, by group.
* Creepage: RES_A (G04) to SELV / PE pairs from the stage-43 res-a-creepage.json, margin over the 12.6 mm floor.
